Revolutionary Communist Group of Colombia () (RCGC) is a Marxist-Leninist-Maoist group in Colombia. It was founded in 1982, by a group originating in the Marxist–Leninist League of Colombia. It is a founding member of the Revolutionary Internationalist Movement.[http://www.revolucionobrera.com/documentos/informe/14.htm Informe Poltitico]
